schedule: One paid runner at a time. Finish and retain all four 71df control results first. Keep that failed/incomplete measurement; do not run its positive phase. The revised candidate receives its own complete control measurement, never a favorable replacement of the old results.
inputChanges: Same generic library paragraph, explicit native submitResult object instruction for the finder, and a resource-class exclusion separating intended codec expansion from an intrinsic defect or shipped unbounded hostile-data consumer. Only production scan-prompts.ts changes; no engine completion shortcut.
invariants: Same source cases and pins, seven classes, model route/effort, step/unit limits, tools and per-case caps.
Same sampler, exact-claim judge protocol, matcher, 60% per-language target and minimum 20 judged or all if fewer.
Preserve original expected-zero control fields and every raw/incomplete/false report; UUID remains an extra diagnostic positive.

controls.advanceCondition: All three valid negatives must finish every planned unit without findings, surface gaps or provider infrastructure errors. Inspect every control finding. Require the confirmed intrinsic UUID uniqueness defect to remain detectable; include all true and false UUID reports in development precision. A prose-only finish with no formal result is not a clean negative.

positive.condition: Only after the revised control assessment passes; never auto-launch on process exit.
positive.sampling: Same 20-smallest-key-hash seeds as continuation-measurement-plan.json. Freeze raw cases/selections before reading descriptions. Confirmation descriptions remain blind during candidate development.

scoring: Development plus all four revised controls, and confirmation separately, each at the unchanged per-language precision threshold. Record strict advisory recall, spend and coverage; source judge is Codex, not independent human review. No quality pass is inferred from tests or zero-output incomplete runs.

diagnostics.contract: Forward inputs, result values and thrown errors unchanged. Bounded event names, numeric HTTP status and lens completion flags/counts only; no model bodies or free-form errors.
